description: ACKS 1e equipment availability by market class. Source: acore_equipment.xml lines 77-84.
notes: Array index 0 = Market Class I, index 5 = Market Class VI.
Integer values = quantity of each specific item available per month.
String percentages = chance that one unit is available that month.
NA = unavailable at that market class.
Bundles of small items sold together count as one item for availability.
